issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing sum(a, b) to add two integers passed on the stack. The reference solution provides a sum function that only reads the first argument (mov eax, [esp+4]) and immediately returns, thus ignoring the second parameter and not performing any addition. This contradicts the specification and would mislead students who consult the solution as the intended implementation.
issues.suggested_fix: Correct the reference solution's sum implementation so it reads both arguments from the stack and returns their sum (e.g., mov eax, [esp+4]; add eax, [esp+8]; ret), or else update the problem statement if a different calling convention/parameter layout was intended. Ensure the solution demonstrates the intended behavior of sum(a, b).
